title: Attribute Synthetic Monitoring costs to teams and services

blocks.content: Attribute Synthetics usage to the teams and services responsible for it by configuring attribution keys, then checking that your checks carry matching values.

blocks.title: Before you begin
blocks.content: This setup is for a Cost attribution admin with permission to edit the chosen Synthetic Monitoring check. Use an existing check you own and your organization’s approved keys and values. Configuring a key does not backfill historical usage.
Review the Synthetics attribution settings before changing how usage is grouped.
Open **Cost Management and Billing → Settings** to review how Synthetics usage is attributed.
blocks.tooltip: Start with the keys your organization uses to divide its costs.

blocks.content: You have reached the settings where Synthetics attribution keys are configured.
Configure a missing attribution key, then review and save its values on an existing check.

blocks.title: Configure keys and label a check

blocks.content: Under **Synthetics attribution**, choose **Configure an attribution label** (or **Select another attribution label** if one key already exists). If the intended keys are already configured, keep them and skip this step plus the next two steps.
blocks.tooltip: Choose a cost dimension that helps your team understand its usage.

blocks.content: Select an existing check label key or enter the approved key your organization uses. You can configure at most two Synthetics attribution keys; retain existing keys.
blocks.tooltip: Reuse an established key so costs follow the labels your checks already carry.

blocks.content: Choose **Save Synthetics Label**, then confirm the key appears under **Synthetics attribution** before continuing.
blocks.tooltip: Confirm the approved key was saved before assigning values to a check.

blocks.content: Open **Checks** to apply your attribution keys to an existing check.
blocks.tooltip: Connect the cost dimension to the checks that generate the usage.

blocks.content: Choose an existing check you own and select its **Edit** control. Pick the check intentionally; keep its unrelated labels and settings.
blocks.tooltip: Use a check whose team or service ownership you know.

blocks.content: Open **Labels** to review the configured cost attribution keys and the values this check already carries.
blocks.tooltip: Compare the configured cost dimensions with this check’s existing values.

blocks.content: In **Cost attribution labels**, enter the correct value for each configured key that needs one. Keep existing correct values: a same-key label may already cover this check. An empty value remains unattributed.
blocks.tooltip: Fill only missing or incorrect values and preserve labels that already describe ownership.

blocks.content: Save the check, then confirm its saved labels still contain the attribution keys and values you intended. Keep unrelated labels unchanged.
blocks.tooltip: Confirm the saved check carries the intended cost dimensions and values.

blocks.content: You have connected the configured cost dimensions to the labels on your check; confirm the saved keys and values before treating attribution as configured.
